gleb.feast_note: July 24 in the Ukrainian Greek Catholic calendar; the 2025 UGCC report documents this celebration. This is not a claim of a General Roman Calendar memorial.

sources.title: Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church: Feast of Saints Borys and Hlib (2025)

gleb.recognition_note: Gleb (Hlib), brother of Borys, is celebrated by the Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church. Shared Orthodox veneration does not exclude Catholic recognition.

gregory-palamas.feast_note: Commemorated on the movable Second Sunday of the Great Fast in the Melkite Catholic tradition. No fixed Gregorian date is assigned here; this is not a General Roman Calendar memorial.

sources.title: Melkite Catholic Diocese of Newton: St. Gregory of Palamas
Melkite Catholic Diocese of Newton: The Fathers Reaffirmed

gregory-palamas.recognition_note: The Melkite Catholic Church explicitly celebrates him as a saint. Retained as an Eastern Catholic recognition, not described as a modern Roman canonization.

sergius-of-radonezh.feast_note: September 25 is recorded by Catholic Online and Catholic Ireland. This reference date does not imply a General Roman Calendar memorial.

sources.title: Catholic Online: St. Sergius of Radonezh
Catholic Near East Welfare Association: Saga of a Saint
Catholic Ireland: St Sergius and the Russian Catholic calendar

sergius-of-radonezh.recognition_note: Catholic Ireland records his inclusion in the liturgical calendar for Russian Catholics in 1940; Catholic Online and CNEWA also cover him as a saint. This is not a claim of a modern papal canonization or universal memorial.
